reason: The original card and A1 do not fully specify the current bounded H0 stream, randomized-QMC prefix construction, the scope of the IID capture argument, or an auditable liveness contract for soft ordering. This amendment resolves those ambiguities before implementation or formal input generation.

reviewed: The committed EXP-DISC-001 card and A1 amendment
The committed SolvePolicy 1.0.0 and ProposalEngine 1.0.0 source
Official QuasiMonteCarlo.jl sampler, randomization and design-matrix documentation
The primary Owen and Matousek references cited or added to the literature matrix
not_reviewed: Any EXP-DISC-001 proposal artifact, generated formal input, local outcome, metric, summary or promotion result
evidence_boundary.restriction: This is a source-only, outcome-unobserved preimplementation amendment. It cannot encode a result-dependent method choice or threshold.

superseded_phrases.phrase: Independently Owen-scrambled Sobol blocks with every point launched.
superseded_phrases.replacement: Use the single-max-prefix randomized-QMC contract below. Independent block randomization is not a promotion candidate.

superseded_phrases.phrase: A single 128-launch trace supplies all smaller prefix checkpoints.
superseded_phrases.replacement: For each randomized method, one 128-column randomized matrix is materialized once and its exact leading columns define checkpoints 8, 16, 32, 64 and 128.

superseded_phrases.phrase: The independent full-support lane satisfies N_independent(t) tending to infinity.
superseded_phrases.replacement: The implemented H0 has an audited nonvanishing IID-labelled proposal cadence; no independence or probabilistic-completeness theorem is attached to that custom counter stream without a separate proof.

relation_to_prior_preregistration.unchanged: The A1 diagnostic exclusion and all original truth, family-disjoint locking, wall/oracle accounting, safety, promotion, kill and two-round tuning limits remain binding unless this amendment makes a strictly narrower claim.

literature.claim: The official interface applies a RandomizationMethod after a deterministic sample matrix has been generated and provides OwenScramble and MatousekScramble.
literature.assumptions: The deterministic sampler, randomization method, base, pad, RNG, package environment and complete matrix shape are fixed.
literature.break_conditions: Fresh calls for different checkpoints or independently randomized blocks do not define the leading prefixes of one randomized matrix.

literature.claim: The official SobolSample interface defaults to NoRand and the current implementation, through Sobol.jl, does not start the sequence at zero.
literature.assumptions: The sampler and package-manifest versions are locked.
literature.break_conditions: Changing package version, inserting zero, skipping a point or regenerating a different length can change every recorded prefix.

literature.claim: The official design-matrix interface distinguishes multiple randomized realizations and warns that its NoRand dimension-splitting construction has no QMC guarantee.
literature.assumptions: Each randomized realization has a declared method and replayable randomization state.
literature.break_conditions: Treating deterministic dimension splits or block concatenations as independent randomized nets invalidates that interpretation.

literature.claim: Owen introduces randomized permutations for digital nets and sequences, the construction identified by the official QuasiMonteCarlo.jl documentation as nested uniform scrambling.
literature.assumptions: The digital-net setting and the paper's stated random permutation construction apply.
literature.break_conditions: Randomization preserves a net construction under its assumptions but does not make points mutually independent or prove root-basin capture.

literature.claim: Matousek analyzes a linear scrambling construction for digital nets; the official QuasiMonteCarlo.jl documentation describes its observed integration performance as similar to Owen scrambling with lower numerical cost.
literature.assumptions: The cited theory and documentation concern discrepancy or randomized integration under their stated digital-net conditions.
literature.break_conditions: Neither source establishes superior root-basin capture, all-root recall or probabilistic completeness for GeoTarget.

policy.bounded_scope_correction: The shell lane is ineligible on the bounded primary scope despite its configured weight. A bounded H0 trace must contain no shell action. Any future unbounded stratum is separate and must preserve the production binary-ruler shell schedule.

proposal_sources.iid_labelled: A deterministic counter-to-coordinate mapping keyed by seed, global task id, dimension and stream id.
proposal_sources.heuristic_through_dimension_64: An unscrambled radical-inverse Halton coordinate indexed by the global task id. H0 lane interleaving therefore selects a sparse task-index subsequence rather than the contiguous prefix used by D-HALTON-ALL.
proposal_sources.heuristic_above_dimension_64: The production counter-based fallback, reported as a separate dimension stratum and never labelled Halton.
proposal_sources.seed_note: For dimensions at most 64, the committed Halton coordinates are determined by task index and base; recording a seed in metadata does not make that stream a randomized replicate.

trace_contract: Persist policy and proposal-engine versions plus source hashes.
Persist every scheduler action with action index, lane, eligibility set, selected weight state and global task id.
Persist raw proposal coordinates and their generation ordinal before local execution.
Persist local-launch, pending/resume, refinement and completion events separately.
Report generated-proposal, local-launch, completed-local, wall-time and oracle-work prefixes separately.
Persist checkpoint/restart metadata and verify trace identity across an uninterrupted and resumed replay before a formal run.
current_h0_control_correction.mechanism_control_note: The historical id D-HALTON-ALL is retained, but its report must say contiguous task-index source: genuine Halton through dimension 64 and the production counter fallback above dimension 64. It must not be presented as replaying H0's sparse interleaved heuristic subsequence or as Halton in the fallback stratum.

refinement_exhaustion_fairness.observed_source_behavior: In the committed coordinator, a nonempty refinement queue after refinement budget exhaustion can set refinement_blocked and disable new IID, heuristic and shell proposals even while proposal or local budget remains. Existing tests preserve that behavior, so D-H0-CURRENT must replay it exactly rather than silently applying a fix.
refinement_exhaustion_fairness.charter_risk: This terminal coupling can violate the intended nonstarvation service of the permanent IID-labelled lane. It is an operational scheduler risk, not evidence that the counter stream is probabilistically independent.

mandatory_counterfactual.single_difference: When refinement budget is exhausted, keep queued refinements explicitly budget-blocked but allow otherwise eligible raw proposal lanes and local launches to continue under their unchanged remaining budgets. Never execute refinement work beyond its budget.
mandatory_counterfactual.fixed_components: Proposal sources, lane weights, IID-labelled cadence, pending semantics, local solver, validator, truth, total budgets and checkpoint accounting are identical to D-H0-CURRENT.
mandatory_counterfactual.production_restriction: This control cannot change production from EXP-DISC-001. Any favorable result may only motivate a separate outcome-unobserved scheduler card, implementation audit and family-disjoint locked gate before production modification.

soft_ordering_factorial: D-H0-CURRENT: current immediate-launch ordering with current refinement-blocking semantics
D-H0-REFINEMENT-NONBLOCKING: current immediate-launch ordering with only the nonblocking counterfactual
D4-H0-SOFT: soft ordering with current refinement-blocking semantics
D4-H0-SOFT-REFINEMENT-NONBLOCKING: the identical soft-ordering policy with only the nonblocking counterfactual

mandatory_family.construction: Analytic finite-root cases that deterministically create at least one queued refinement before the refinement budget is exhausted, retain positive proposal and local budget afterward, and place an unrecovered Gold target in a basin reachable by a later raw IID-labelled or heuristic proposal.
mandatory_family.validity: Reject a generated case before use unless the frozen control trace proves the refinement-blocked precondition and positive remaining proposal/local budgets without using target outcome to set a threshold. Development and locked instances use disjoint generator seeds.

required_trace_fields: refinement queue length and oldest enqueue ordinal
proposal and local budgets used and remaining
refinement_blocked and allow_new state transitions with reason
number and lane of proposals suppressed after refinement exhaustion
IID-labelled generation and local-launch cadence after refinement exhaustion
gate: The exact H0 controls remain valid comparators even if they stop raw proposal lanes.
A nonblocking counterfactual must never exceed the refinement budget, discard queued work, bypass canonical validation or increase false targets.

Report paired full-target recall, action, launch, completion, wall and oracle-work deltas on REFINEMENT-BUDGET-BLOCK and every unrelated family; a later launch is not credited until its local completion is accounted.
If the counterfactual does not restore the declared IID-labelled service while raw proposal/local budget remains, or causes any critical-stratum regression under the original gates, reject it.
Even if it passes this DISC attribution gate, production behavior remains unchanged until a separately preregistered scheduler ablation passes untouched family-disjoint validation.

construction: For each problem instance, randomized replicate and method, generate one deterministic 128-column Sobol matrix in the unit cube.
Apply exactly one post-generation randomization to that complete matrix using an explicit scramble RNG initialized from the method-specific frozen scramble seed.

Transform and persist the randomized matrix before any solver outcome is observed; store its shape, element type, exact bytes or lossless representation, checksum, seed namespace, RNG type, sampler, method, base, pad, Julia version and locked package-manifest hash.
Define checkpoints only as exact leading columns of the persisted 128-column matrix. Calls that regenerate a matrix at checkpoint length are forbidden.
The proposal batch size of 32 controls execution or storage chunking only. Changing the chunk size must not change any coordinate, checksum or prefix.

scramble_parameters.rng: Explicitly constructed Random.Xoshiro from the frozen scramble seed; Random.default_rng is forbidden. Exact replay is grounded in the persisted matrix, not assumed RNG portability.
scramble_parameters.sobol_origin: Use the nonzero-start convention of the locked QuasiMonteCarlo.jl/Sobol.jl implementation, record the first deterministic column and environment hashes, and do not insert or skip a zero point post hoc.
scramble_parameters.paired_seed_rule: Owen and Matousek variants use disjoint method namespaces derived from the same declared replicate id; seed derivation is frozen before generation.

variants.method: QuasiMonteCarlo.OwenScramble with base=2, pad=32 and an explicit RNG
QuasiMonteCarlo.MatousekScramble with base=2, pad=32 and an explicit RNG

randomized_qmc_contract.cost_and_claim_boundary: Charge deterministic sampling, scrambling, persistence and replay validation to end-to-end and sampling-overhead metrics. The documented lower numerical cost of Matousek scrambling is an integration-implementation motivation for measuring both methods, not a prior claim about root-basin recall.
randomized_qmc_contract.method_selection: Stage A compares both variants under the original paired development design. At most one method may feed D3-MIXED or an integrated ordering candidate; its rule and result are frozen before Stage B and locked validation. This consumes the existing tuning allowance and creates no extra post-outcome substitution.
randomized_qmc_contract.mixed_stream_contract: For every D3-MIXED fraction, persist a deterministic 128-entry lane schedule with its phase before outcomes. Consume the next column of separately materialized D0 and selected-RQMC maximum-prefix matrices whenever their lane appears; never regenerate, skip or replace a point. The schedule, source-column indices and merged coordinates must be identical under every execution batch size.
randomized_qmc_contract.block_only_randomization: If concatenated independently randomized 32-column blocks are retained for attribution, label them D-REPORT-BLOCK-RQMC, exclude them from promotion and completeness claims, and do not describe the concatenation as one scrambled net.

iid_claim_boundary.operational_invariant: For production H0, audit its cadence on proposal-lane selections, excluding pending and refinement actions from that denominator. For every soft or mixed candidate, also audit the separately declared raw-IID local-launch cadence at every discovery-launch prefix. Both counts require zero violations and must not be conflated with total scheduler actions.
iid_claim_boundary.conditional_capture_statement: The formula 1 - (1 - mu(B))^n may be reported only for n proposals that are explicitly modeled as mutually independent uniform draws and only for a measurable basin B of normalized measure mu(B).
not_covered: Points within one Sobol or scrambled-Sobol matrix
Concatenated independently scrambled blocks considered as one net
The committed counter-based H0 IID-labelled lane absent a separate proof of joint independence
Any conclusion that a finite run exhausted all roots
iid_claim_boundary.reporting_rule: Use 'IID-labelled lane' for H0 mechanism reporting. Reserve 'IID capture guarantee' for D0 only under the declared independent-uniform experimental model, and continue to report search exhaustion as unknown.

held_fixed: local solver, canonical validator, truth and budgets
mandatory_ablation.allowed_difference: The candidate may use charged residual and k-nearest-neighbor information to reorder eligible raw starts through a deferred FIFO-with-aging queue; it may never discard or mutate a proposal.
mandatory_ablation.adaptive_trace_note: Ordering can causally change completion, refinement and later global task ids. Therefore persist and compare both full traces; do not claim coordinate-identical pairing after their adaptive schedules diverge.

soft_ordering_contract.refinement_factor_note: The mandatory H0 soft-ordering ablation is evaluated under both current refinement-blocking and the research-only nonblocking counterfactual declared above. Compare ordering only within the same refinement factor; compare refinement blocking only within the same ordering factor.
soft_ordering_contract.selected_stream_ablation: If Stage A selects a non-H0 source or mix for an integrated candidate, compare its soft-ordered form with an otherwise identical FIFO form. The H0-versus-D4-H0-SOFT ablation remains mandatory and is not replaced by that comparison.

liveness.queue_rule: Deferred proposals are ordered by immutable enqueue ordinal. New proposals enter behind every proposal already waiting.
liveness.service_rule: Let q be the frozen positive deferred-launches-per-wave value and let W be the frozen proposal batch size. At least q oldest deferred proposals are launched in every W eligible discovery-service opportunities. A proposal with A deferred proposals ahead at enqueue must therefore launch within W * ceil((A + 1) / q) such opportunities, unless the run reaches a preregistered hard wall first. An IID-labelled proposal may not be deferred past its separately frozen launch-cadence boundary.
liveness.hard_wall_rule: A proposal still queued at a wall or checkpoint is recorded as censored/unserved-at-budget, with age and proposals-ahead, rather than automatically counted as an algorithmic starvation violation.
liveness.starvation_violation: Count a soft-ordering violation only when that ordering layer exceeds the declared service bound while eligible service continues, reorders the immutable FIFO age, discards a proposal, or blocks an IID-labelled, pending or refinement service obligation. A stop caused by the exact H0 refinement-exhaustion rule is logged under refinement_exhaustion_fairness instead of being relabelled as soft-queue starvation.
liveness.completion_boundary: Deferred liveness guarantees launch service, not local completion. A launched but unfinished attempt is reported separately as pending at the checkpoint.

required_metrics: maximum deferred age in eligible discovery-service opportunities
unserved deferred count at every launch and wall checkpoint
sampling, residual-screening, graph-construction and scheduler overhead fractions
soft_ordering_contract.decision_rule: Retain the original zero safety-violation rule, ten-percent overhead ceiling and within-five-percent removal rule. Any speed or recall claim must be shown at both action and completed-local accounting boundaries so deferred work cannot create an apparent gain.

execution_order_addendum: Freeze the original card, A1 and A2 together, then freeze source and environment hashes.
Implement only the input/proposal materialization seam and static replay contract; do not inspect outcomes while fixing prefix identity.
Stage A compares D0-IID-ALL, D1-SOBOL-ALL, D-HALTON-ALL, D-H0-CURRENT, D2O-RQMC-OWEN-ALL, D2M-RQMC-MATOUSEK-ALL and the preregistered mixed candidates.
Freeze at most one randomized method and the allowed mix under the original two-round development limit.
Stage B runs the mandatory H0 soft-ordering ablation and, if applicable, one selected-stream FIFO-versus-soft ablation.
Stage B also runs the frozen refinement-blocking-by-ordering factorial and the REFINEMENT-BUDGET-BLOCK family; its counterfactual is attribution-only and cannot modify production.
Only after all implementation audits and development freezes run one untouched family-disjoint locked validation.

tuning_round_interpretation.round_1: One preregistered Stage A joint comparison selects, at most once, the randomized method and IID mixture from the original finite domains. Inspecting the joint table counts as the first tuning round; rerunning a narrowed grid is forbidden.
tuning_round_interpretation.round_2: One preregistered Stage B joint comparison selects, at most once, among the original finite screening-block, k and positive deferred-quota choices. Inspecting that table counts as the second tuning round; no Stage B rerun or threshold change is allowed.
tuning_round_interpretation.no_reset: The method split introduced by A2 does not reset or enlarge the original two-round limit. Locked validation permits no tuning.

freeze_rule: Commit this amendment with A1 and the original card before creating any formal EXP-DISC-001 input or proposal matrix. Persisted matrices, manifests and all downstream results must name all three preregistration hashes.
